general_information.Description: Create a digital product follow the design process: research, empathize with users, identify pain points, finding solutions, create wireframes and prototype, test and iterate on designs. Practice UX research: like planning research studies, conducting interviews and usability studies, and synthesizing research results Apply foundational UX concepts, like user-centered design, accessibility, and equity-focused design - Students must work in a group. The number of members for each group, decided by the Head Academic of campus, could be variable from 2 to 3 students - The project is done in 4 stages with feedback and discussion at each stage. Students are expected to discuss, organise, present and critique their work with a high level of professionalism, and implement research strategies that contribute to the overall finished project 1) Progress on Project (04 reports): 45% - Report 1: 15% - Report 2: 10% - Report 3: 10% - Report 4: 10% Mark of each report must be >= 4/10. 2) Final Documents (By Instructor): 5% Final Documents (By Instructor) >=4 3) Project Defense - Final Documents (By Council): 20%; - Oral Project Defense: 30% Project Defense >=4 4) Final results:100%; Final Result >=5/10 Final Products and Final Documents must be submitted before deadline
general_information.StudentTasks: (1)Choose the project within the selected concentration (2)Students are required to attend at least 80% of scheduled meetings with their supervisor(s) to be eligible for the thesis or capstone defense. (3)Attend all scheduled meetings with supervisor (4)Produce document and product according to project requirement (5)Defense individually work in front of examination board

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify and frame a user experience problem within a specific domain by applying relevant theoretical frameworks and research methods, while demonstrating awareness of social responsibilities and compliance with legal, ethical, and contextual constraints.
Analyze user behaviors, needs, motivations, and frustrations, along with stakeholder perspectives, using synthesis methods such as empathy mapping, persona building, and user journey mapping.
Generate interface design concepts through information architecture, wireframing that respond to the defined problem and align with user goals and technical feasibility.

Build interactive prototypes using digital tools (e.g., Figma), supported by a finalized UI design and visual system (including logo and branding guidelines) that clearly express the product identity.
Conduct usability testing or heuristic evaluation, analyze feedback, and iteratively refine the product to improve usability, consistency, and alignment with user expectations.
Apply project planning and collaboration tools (e.g., Trello, Jira, Miro, Git) to manage team responsibilities, track progress, and document decision-making processes.
Present the project solution through a structured design document, visual communication (poster, slides), oral presentation and defend with clarity and professionalism.

Evaluate critically and integrate ethically integrate sources and tools—including generative AI—by reflecting on their credibility, limitations, and ethical implications. Propose responsible approaches to maintain sustainability and uphold human values.

schedule.Student's Tasks: - One month before the graduation semester, students are required to conduct Literature Review research to have 3 proposals to pitch with mentors on the first week of graduation semester - On the first week, student will continue conduct further Literature Review and COmpetitor research to finalize proposal
- Conduct Field Research planning - Field Research Data Collection
- Synthesize and analyze data to extract insights to define problems of user using different frameworks (persona, CJM,..)
- Present and defense report 1 with mentors
- Ideate features for the solutions - Conduct Technology research in order to finalize features for the problems
- Develop Information Architecture based on finalized features - Develop user flows based on User journey and IA
- Develop first testing plan for the med-fi wireframes - Conduct testing
- Review testing results - Analyze to extract insight - Refine wireframe based on testing results
-Conduct visual research to define moodboards and visual direction of the solution - Develop first UI version for the solutions - Submit Report 3
- Develop testing plan for the first UI version - Conduct testing
- Review testing results - Analyze to extract insight - Refine UI based on testing results
- Finalize Design System and UI - Finalize Simulation video and prototype - Submit Report 4
- Prepare & submit deliverables for Final Documents submission
